subject.title: fix(gateway): Control UI bootstrap 401s over Tailscale Serve without a token

question: Should Control UI HTTP bootstrap/media/avatar reads accept tokenless Tailscale identity, and if so must they enforce the same browser-origin policy as the WebSocket Control UI path?
rationale: Current code and docs intentionally scope tokenless Tailscale identity to the Control UI WebSocket path, while this PR expands that boundary to HTTP read routes that can be triggered by browsers.

options.title: Allow with origin gate
options.body: Permit the new `http-control-ui` Tailscale surface only after applying the WS-equivalent browser-origin policy, adding a disallowed-origin regression test, updating docs, and requiring runtime proof.

options.title: Keep HTTP token-bound
options.body: Reject the HTTP auth-surface expansion and solve the dashboard bootstrap/media gap through bearer or device-token reads instead.

options.title: Accept broader reads
options.body: Intentionally accept tailnet-authenticated tokenless HTTP reads without a browser-origin gate, but document the cross-origin exposure and security assumption explicitly.

recommendation.title: Allow with origin gate
recommendation.body: Permit the new `http-control-ui` Tailscale surface only after applying the WS-equivalent browser-origin policy, adding a disallowed-origin regression test, updating docs, and requiring runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter authored the prior Tailscale auth hardening and WebSocket-only scoping that this PR changes.
